input.query: SELECT service_name AS svc, span_name, attr_span_kind kind, count(*) n, approx_quantile(duration/1e6, 0.95) p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-train-service','ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT service_name, metric, round(avg(value),2) avg_v FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE service_name='ts-train-service' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 60

content.text: ts-train-service's own container and JVM metrics are flat (CPU 0.03, memory steady), but its database-type spans (`SELECT ts.train_type`, `TrainTypeRepository.*`) run at about 7 s p95. Next I'll check the network view of train→mysql and the normal-period baseline for the same spans.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' p, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2) v, count(*) n FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE (attr_source LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2), count(*) FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE (attr_source LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT p, span_name, count(*) n, approx_quantile(d, 0.95) p95_ms FROM (SELECT 'norm' p, span_name, duration/1e6 d FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-train-service' UNION ALL SELECT 'abn', span_name, duration/1e6 FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-train-service') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: The train-service database spans went from roughly 1–2 ms to about 7 s, while the handler and repository spans grew in step with them. The network query was too large, so I'll narrow it to the train→mysql connection.

input.query: SELECT p, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2) v, count(*) n FROM (SELECT 'abn' p, * FROM abnormal_metrics_sum UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', * FROM normal_metrics_sum) WHERE attr_source='ts-train-service' AND attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT p, service_name, span_name, count(*) n, approx_quantile(d, 0.95) p95_ms FROM (SELECT 'norm' p, service_name, span_name, duration/1e6 d FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-plan-service') AND span_name IN ('GET','POST') UNION ALL SELECT 'abn', service_name, span_name, duration/1e6 FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-plan-service') AND span_name IN ('GET','POST')) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: Routing is consistent: basic, travel, travel2, route-plan and travel-plan all show their slow POST/GET server spans only where they wait on train-service. Next I'll check whether the slowdown is on the wire (network) or inside train's DB calls, by looking at the hubble rows that reach mysql.

input.query: SELECT p, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2) v, count(*) n FROM (SELECT 'abn' p, * FROM abnormal_metrics_sum UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', * FROM normal_metrics_sum) WHERE attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%' OR attr_source LIKE '%mysql%' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,1,3
SELECT p, metric, round(avg(value),3) v FROM (SELECT 'abn' p, * FROM abnormal_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', * FROM normal_metrics) WHERE service_name='mysql' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1 LIMIT 40

content.text: Network flows into train-service's mysql connection look normal, and the host CPU and memory are flat, so the slowdown is inside train's DB calls. Last, I'll confirm the call chain with parent→child span joins across services.

input.query: SELECT p.service_name AS caller, c.service_name AS callee, count(*) n, approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6, 0.95) callee_p95_ms, approx_quantile(p.duration/1e6, 0.95) caller_p95_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id = p.trace_id WHERE c.service_name <> p.service_name AND c.attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY caller_p95_ms DESC
